branches.check: Check the gas bottle.
branches.remedy: Replenish it as necessary.

branches.cause: Shielding-gas flow is too low or too high
branches.check: Check the regulator for proper flow.
branches.remedy: Set the documented gas flow.

specifics.text: MIG: With adequate ventilation and no gas leak, open the cylinder valve fully and set shielding-gas flow to 20–30 SCFH.

branches.check: Inspect the weld area for contamination.
branches.remedy: Clean the workpiece down to bare metal.

branches.cause: Gun is too far from the workpiece
branches.check: Check contact-tip-to-work distance.
branches.remedy: Use the proper CTWD for the procedure.

branches.check: Verify DCEP for MIG or DCEN for self-shielded flux-cored welding.
branches.remedy: Correct the polarity.

specifics.text: For MIG, ground is negative and wire feed power is positive.
For flux-cored, ground is positive and wire feed power is negative.

branches.check: Inspect the wire for rust and residue.
branches.remedy: Use clean wire free of rust and residue.
